title: Shopping day
objectives: inquire about prices with How much is it?
handle cash and card payment interactions

teacherNotes.title: Stage aim
teacherNotes.content: Greet student and introduce lesson objectives for Shopping day.
Welcome to today's lesson: Shopping day! Today we will practice how to inquire about prices with How much is it?.

elements.content: inquire about prices with How much is it?; handle cash and card payment interactions

teacherNotes.title: Stage aim
teacherNotes.content: Introduce target vocabulary and key language structures using concept check questions.

elements.content: Review key terms and target language below:
Key terms: buy, cost, pay, cash, card, price

teacherNotes.title: Stage aim
teacherNotes.content: Check understanding through controlled choice exercise.

elements.content: What phrase asks for the price of an item?

teacherNotes.title: Stage aim
teacherNotes.content: Develop reading comprehension and listening skills.

teacherNotes.title: Listening Tapescript
teacherNotes.content: How much is this book? It costs ten dollars. Can I pay by card?

elements.content: Read the short passage below (recycling introduced vocabulary):
Today is shopping day! How much does this cost? I want to buy it and pay with my card.
Listening Task: Listen to your teacher / audio prompt and answer the comprehension question.

teacherNotes.title: Stage aim
teacherNotes.content: Provide communicative speaking practice and personalized interaction.

elements.content: Roleplay buying items at a store and making payments with cash or card.

teacherNotes.title: Stage aim
teacherNotes.content: Review key corrections and confirm homework task.
Great work today! Remember to review target words in your mobile app before our next class.

elements.content: Today you practiced: inquire about prices with How much is it?, handle cash and card payment interactions.
